methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for leading AI music generators was collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible. Pages that rendered via JavaScript only (Mubert Render, Loudly, Soundraw, Udio) could not be fully parsed by automated fetch; for these, figures were taken from independent 2026 pricing-comparison sources (unite.ai, beebom.com, futurepedia.io, elegantthemes.com, slashdot.org) and cross-checked across at least two sources before inclusion. AIVA publishes prices exclusively in EUR; no USD self-serve price exists on their official page, so monthlyUsd is null for all AIVA plans with EUR figures recorded in notes. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month list price for flat tiers; where a vendor only publishes annual billing, monthlyUsd is the per-month equivalent at annual billing and the month-to-month rate (if known) is in notes. annualDiscountPct is set when both billing periods are publicly confirmed. These are non-telephony products: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan. hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless explicitly advertised. quote-only tiers carry monthlyUsd: null.

vendors.name: Suno
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from suno.com/pricing on 2026-06-14; page rendered successfully. Pro saves $24/yr, Premier saves $72/yr confirmed on page. Corroborated by unite.ai review.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 daily credits (~10 songs/day). v4.5-all model access. 8-minute audio upload limit. Shared queue. No commercial use rights. Cannot purchase add-on credits.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $10/mo billed monthly; $8/mo equivalent billed annually (saves $24/yr). 2,500 monthly credits (~500 songs). v5.5 model access. Commercial rights. 30-minute audio upload limit. Priority queue (10 concurrent). Stem splitting. Add-on credit purchases available.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: $30/mo billed monthly; $24/mo equivalent billed annually (saves $72/yr). 10,000 monthly credits (~2,000 songs). v5.5 model access. Suno Studio access. Commercial rights. 30-minute audio upload limit. Priority queue (10 concurrent). Stem extraction. Voice customization. Add-on credits available.

vendors.name: Udio
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page udio.com/pricing returned only a page title with no pricing table (JavaScript-rendered). Prices sourced from unite.ai 2026 review and corroborated by alternativeto.net which confirms price range $8-$30/mo. futurepedia.io lists a Pro tier starting at $10/mo.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10 daily credits plus 100 monthly credits. No commercial use rights.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $10/mo billed monthly; $8/mo equivalent billed annually. 2,400 monthly credits. Commercial rights included. Sourced from aggregator (unite.ai) — official page JS-only.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $30/mo billed monthly; $24/mo equivalent billed annually. 6,000 monthly credits. Sourced from aggregator (unite.ai) — official page JS-only.

vendors.name: Soundraw
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page soundraw.io/pricing returned 404. Prices sourced from futurepedia.io (monthly rates: Creator $16.99, Artist Starter $29.99, Artist Pro $35.99, Artist Unlimited $49.99) and corroborated by unite.ai (annual equivalents: $11.04, $19.49, $23.39, $32.50). Note: soundraw.io homepage showed EUR prices (€5.83–€17.42/mo annual) suggesting geo-currency; USD figures from aggregators used as primary.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $16.99/mo billed monthly; ~$11.04/mo equivalent billed annually (~35% off). Unlimited MP3 downloads. Commercial use included. Sourced from aggregators — official page returned 404.

plans.name: Artist Starter
plans.notes: $29.99/mo billed monthly; ~$19.49/mo equivalent billed annually (~35% off). 10 monthly downloads (MP3). Distribute and monetize on streaming platforms. Sourced from aggregators — official page returned 404.

plans.name: Artist Pro
plans.notes: $35.99/mo billed monthly; ~$23.39/mo equivalent billed annually (~35% off). 20 monthly downloads (MP3, WAV, stems). Sourced from aggregators — official page returned 404.

plans.name: Artist Unlimited
plans.notes: $49.99/mo billed monthly; ~$32.50/mo equivalent billed annually (~35% off). Unlimited downloads (MP3, WAV, stems). No download caps. Sourced from aggregators — official page returned 404.

plans.name: Enterprise / API
plans.notes: Contact sales. Enterprise plan for 10+ employees. API plan also contact-only. No published price.

vendors.name: AIVA
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from aiva.ai/pricing on 2026-06-14; page rendered successfully. AIVA publishes pricing exclusively in EUR; no USD self-serve price is listed on the official site. monthlyUsd is null for all paid plans. EUR figures recorded in notes. Free plan confirmed at €0/mo.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: €0/mo. 3 downloads per month (MP3 and MIDI). Track durations up to 3 minutes. Copyright retained by AIVA; no monetization allowed. Credit must be given to AIVA.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: €11/mo billed annually (26% discount applied; month-to-month rate not published). 15 downloads per month (MP3 and MIDI). Track durations up to 5 minutes. Limited monetization on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, and Instagram only. Copyright owned by user. USD price not published by AIVA; approximate USD equivalent ~$12/mo at time of research.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: €33/mo billed annually (33% discount applied; month-to-month rate not published). 300 downloads per month. Durations up to 5 min 30 sec. All file formats (MP3, MIDI, WAV high quality). Full monetization rights; full copyright ownership. USD price not published by AIVA; approximate USD equivalent ~$36/mo at time of research.

vendors.name: Mubert
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page mubert.com/render/pricing is JavaScript-rendered; no pricing table was retrievable. Starting price of $11.69/mo for paid plans sourced from elegantthemes.com 2026 review. Ambassador (free) plan details from same source. Corroborated by toolpilot.ai which confirms '4 membership packages' starting at $11.69/mo. Full plan breakdown unavailable from verifiable sources; only the entry-level paid price is recorded.

plans.name: Ambassador
plans.notes: Free plan. Includes NFT soundtracks, no attribution required, no watermark, lossless quality. Limited generation features.

plans.name: Paid (entry)
plans.notes: Starting price for first paid tier per elegantthemes.com aggregator review. Official page is JS-only; individual plan names and full tier breakdown could not be retrieved. Mubert offers up to 25% savings on annual billing per their page header text. Higher tiers exist but prices unverified.

vendors.name: Loudly
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page loudly.com/pricing returned 404; other Loudly subpages also returned 404 or rendered JS-only. Starting paid price sourced from two independent aggregators: beebom.com ('Personal plan starts at $10/month') and slashdot.org ('Pricing Starts At: $9.99 per month'). Free tier confirmed on both. Full plan breakdown unavailable from verifiable 2026 sources.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free plan with limited downloads. Up to 3 downloads per month per slashdot.org. AI music generation, remixer, and sample pack features accessible.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Starting paid plan at ~$9.99–$10/mo per aggregator sources (slashdot.org: $9.99/mo; beebom.com: $10/mo). Official pricing page was inaccessible; full feature details and higher tiers not verifiable from 2026 sources.

vendors.name: Boomy

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Creator

plans.name: Pro
